## 1. Package Name And Scientific Purpose

SCI-FRUIT defines what a declared model-feedback procedure means and what its
results may claim. Protecting a model from a residual-processing operation
does not establish the model's correctness, true-sky identity, recovery of
lost modes, unit response or downstream fitness. Candidate, accepted and
applied model, measured signal and result remain distinct scientific objects.

## 2. Scientific Boundary And Typed Composition

The boundary starts with the exact iteration input and scientific state under
a declared method, with immutable original measured-parent ancestry. It
includes model construction/selection/acceptance, declared removal, residual
processing, bypass and rejoin, successor state and iteration/terminal identity.
It ends with a completed iteration bundle or separate immutable terminal
selection plus the selected bundle. Downstream inference and use are separate.

Use distinct m_k^candidate, m_k^accepted and m_k^applied in their exact
method-dependent spaces. Let M_k=M_k^applied be the applied-model space,
Y_k the removal-input space and Z_k the result space. Bind y_k^in in Y_k,
Pi_k: M_k -> Y_k, F_k: Y_k -> Z_k and B_k: M_k -> Z_k.
The ordinary conditional role order is
remove -> residual process with exactly named model bypass -> rejoin:

\[
\rho_k=y_k^{\rm in}-\Pi_k(m_k^{\rm applied}),\qquad
z_k=F_k(\rho_k)+B_k(m_k^{\rm applied}).
\]

Equality m_k^applied = m_k^accepted requires an exact method/state equality.
Every normalization, clipping, sign conversion, support restriction, projection,
unit conversion or other transformation between those roles must be explicit.

Changing a coefficient-recomputation rule, learning/model-construction rule,
operator family, role order, sign, bypass graph, support rule, recurrence,
parent route, grouping, stopping rule, terminal selector or failure behavior
creates a new method identity. Different coefficient values, learned states,
accepted models or applied models under an unchanged method create distinct
state, iteration and application generations. These identities are not aliases.
Bind exact locations and application counts under the declared operation graph.
There is no Pi=B or inverse assumption, domain equality,
linear F assumption, equal support, universal upstream bypass, default input
rule, model truth or unit-response inference.

When only F_k=A_k is exact fixed linear, use

\[
z_k=A_k y_k^{\rm in}-A_k[\Pi_k(m_k^{\rm applied})]
    +B_k(m_k^{\rm applied}).
\]

Only when A_k, Pi_k and B_k are all exact fixed linear maps define
D_k=B_k-A_k o Pi_k and z_k=A_k y_k^in+D_k m_k^applied, where o denotes
composition. Every composition binds domains, codomains, units, support,
state and conditioning. If Pi_k or B_k is nonlinear, retain the map-valued
expression and do not infer linear model response or covariance.
The [response and uncertainty table](RESPONSE_AND_UNCERTAINTY_FAMILIES.md)
states these complete linear premises for model response and covariance.
Other procedures retain the full F_k
graph; a fixed basis or recomputed coefficient alone licenses no expansion.

## 3. Legitimate Inputs And Iteration-Input Rule

Every input binds quantity, unit, frame, domain/shape/axes, timing where
applicable, grouping, support/validity, missing/non-finite causes, exact
producer/model parent and method/state generations. The
[notation and role taxonomy](NOTATION_AND_ROLE_TAXONOMY.md) is the input/type
crosswalk. A common shape, time or unit label is not scientific identity.

| Input class | Scientific meaning | Numerical availability in this packet |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Immutable measured parent and exact y_k^in | Selected route supplies exact quantity, unit, frame, response, beam/template convention, calibration, support, validity, lifecycle and provenance; iteration input follows its separately declared rule | This packet selects no parent route or universal input unit |
| Target and separate candidate, accepted and applied models | Exact target quantity; external or internally learned origin; candidate/selection/acceptance/application identities, transformations, state and model-domain support | No sky prior, target representation, model construction or numerical model |
| Pi_k, F_k, B_k and applied state | Declared compatible maps, complete operation graph and role-specific state | All numerical operators and application-specific choices unavailable |
| S_k and initialization/continuation | Exact scientific state and causal dependencies, lineage/branch and method/parent/state generations | No numerical state realization or checkpoint sufficiency claim |
| Response/uncertainty input when used | Exact query/conditioning/domain, parent/model/cross dependence, omitted variation and NOI generation meaning | No numerical response, covariance or uncertainty method |
| Method/control declarations | Learning, support, update, convergence, limits, terminal selection and failure | Required method record unavailable_pending_separate_owner_approval |

If the selected route is the ordinary PTC-to-MAP route, retain its currently
authorized calibrated-x-derived nonpolarimetric total-intensity-equivalent,
top-of-atmosphere point-source-equivalent mJy/beam convention and originating
fixed nominal beam/template, spectral and calibration lineage. This conditional
example establishes neither Stokes I, true sky, a generic FRUIT target nor a
universal input unit. The future numerical method binds one exact parent route
and all required domain conversions; equal shape or unit labels establish no
compatibility.

Every numerical method states whether y_k^in is the immutable original
parent, previous z_(k-1), a product/residual reconstructed from original parent
and cumulative model, or another exact product. It supplies any necessary
domain conversion. Returning to the original parent and reprocessing the prior
result are different methods even with the same model update. Iteration
provides no default recurrence; base-parent ancestry remains in every lineage.

## 4. Required Iteration And Terminal Outputs

Every completed iteration bundle contains the required roles with exact
identities, values or permitted typed statuses: immutable
base parent; exact input; method, lineage, branch and absolute iteration
identity; target/model identities; separate m_k^candidate, m_k^accepted and
m_k^applied and their states and transformations; projected
removal contribution; residual; processed residual; model-rejoin contribution;
result; update/successor state; path support/influence; information origin;
response states; uncertainty states; validity/causes; continuation state;
completion/failure state; and provenance. Numerical path components may be
materialized or exactly reconstructible.

The conditional core defines universal minimum bundle structure and hard
claim dependencies. A method may add required roles and declare which optional
companions a named result or use needs. It may not waive immutable parent
identity; exact iteration input; accepted and applied model identities;
removal, residual-processing and rejoin roles; iteration result; path support
and information origin; lifecycle and causes; state and generation; provenance;
or truthful response and uncertainty status. The
[universal completion gates](ITERATION_STATE_LIFECYCLE.md) apply to every method.
Typed unavailable roles may coexist with a complete iteration only where the
core and exact method permit that narrower claim. Missing science is never
zero, identity, successful bypass or permission to omit a required role.

A terminal product is a separate immutable selection record plus an immutable
completed iteration bundle. It never mutates or relabels that iteration. A
consumer receives the underlying method-defined product role and full FRUIT
terminal lineage, not a new generic parent class inferred from FRUIT ancestry.
The [state/lifecycle table](ITERATION_STATE_LIFECYCLE.md) defines these roles.

## 5. Producer, FRUIT And Downstream Responsibilities

ALIGN/AST retain coordinate/event meaning; RTC/CAL conditioning/calibration;
PTC cleaning/coefficient families; MAP/JINC estimands, normalization, grouping
and numerical admission; NOI its ensemble/uncertainty authority. Other named
producers retain their own exact product and transformation authority.

FRUIT's method owner owns internal model selection, update, transition,
convergence, stopping and terminal selection, and records producer facts/local
completeness. Downstream owners retain Pointing, OOF, source inference,
catalogue and other consumer-specific admission. SCI-VAL may bind and evaluate
an exact approved named-use policy; it does not author or execute FRUIT
recurrence, select models, advance iterations or choose a terminal product.
A missing downstream profile does not erase an otherwise complete FRUIT
iteration/terminal product. Completeness does not establish consumer fitness.

## 6. State, Grouping, Support And Conventions

S_0 is initial seed state. The generic transition is

\[
(S_k,y_k^{\rm in})\longrightarrow
(m_k^{\rm candidate},m_k^{\rm accepted},m_k^{\rm applied},
 \rho_k,z_k,S_{k+1}),
\]

with core-permitted not_applicable or unavailable states where needed and no
default update rule. After completed N, exact continuation
consumes S_(N+1) at next index N+1. Restart creates a new lineage. Seed,
continuation, restart, relearned successor, branch, retry, completion, terminal
selection and publication retain separate identities.

Use grouping-neutral application_scope_resolved and exact learned_candidate,
resolved_model_state, applied_model_state and realized_iteration_state roles;
not every model is fitted. Every numerical method binds one exact grouping
and its shared dependence. Observation/coadd FRUIT and independent/joint
learning do not commute by implication.

Factor every operation and consequential state component into exactly one of
the seven categories in the [state table](ITERATION_STATE_LIFECYCLE.md).
Retain PTC fixed-subspace/recomputed-coefficient application, frozen-component
subtraction and fully relearned state as distinct procedures.
An unchanged fixed-subspace/recomputed-coefficient method retains its identity
while publishing exact new coefficient/application state for each realization
or iteration.

The [support/information-origin table](SUPPORT_INFORMATION_ORIGIN.md)
separates all eight required roles and residual-and-model, residual-only,
model-only and unavailable outputs. Undefined unequal-support behavior makes
the affected output unavailable. No implicit filling, extrapolation,
imputation, renormalization, nearest substitution or model completion is
permitted. Model-only information is model/prior-supported; no path or
iteration creates acquired exposure or an independent observation.

## 7. Required Conditional Science And Predictions

The response catalog has exactly seven roles, with the first six required
roles and the retained parent-held-fixed role listed separately:

1. RF-01 fixed one-step measured-input response.
2. RF-02 fixed one-step model-input response.
3. RF-03 one-step FRUIT full-procedure response.
4. RF-04 recursive multi-iteration response.
5. RF-05 selected-terminal response.
6. RF-06 whole-chain response.
7. RF-07 FRUIT full-procedure response with upstream parent held fixed.

For each role bind what is perturbed, held fixed and rerun/relearned; baseline
and perturbed domains; branch/support/selection comparability; response
codomain; and unavailable/discontinuity behavior. An online adaptive filter
remains a separately authored estimator and is not introduced here.

Preserve the exact typed composition; complete conditional joint covariance
of measured input and applied model with parent-model cross terms; separate
uncertainty sources and exact NOI fixed/dependent-successor/relearned methods;
continuation-sufficient state; distinct completion/resource/convergence/stop/
failure/selection/fitness propositions; and immutable iteration/terminal roles.

Preserve and derive all twenty [required predictions](REQUIRED_CONDITIONAL_PREDICTIONS.md)
under their explicit premises. Branch, threshold, support or selection changes
may make derivatives unavailable. Algebraic limiting cases and state-equality
criteria are scientific predictions, not experiments run or numerical defaults
selected by this Stage A repair.
